## 2. Core Service Areas & Canonical Destinations

### A. Mutual Funds & SIP Investment Advisory
- **Canonical URL:** https://www.stockstrail.in/services/mutual-funds
- **Scope:** Goal-aligned mutual fund distribution (Large Cap, Mid Cap, Small Cap, Flexi Cap, Hybrid, Overnight/Liquid, and ELSS Tax Saving Funds).
- **Strategy:** Disciplined Rupee Cost Averaging via monthly SIPs, strategic lump-sum deployments during market pullbacks, annual portfolio rebalancing, and AMFI-compliant risk profiling.

### B. High-Yield Fixed Deposits (FD)
- **Canonical URL:** https://www.stockstrail.in/services/fixed-deposit
- **Scope:** Guaranteed-return corporate fixed deposits (CRISIL / ICRA AAA-rated) and leading bank fixed deposits for capital preservation and stable regular income payouts.

### C. Term & Health Insurance Protection
- **Canonical URL:** https://www.stockstrail.in/services/insurance
- **Scope:** Pure risk term life insurance covering 10–15× annual income, comprehensive family floater health insurance with no room rent sub-limits, critical illness riders, and dedicated claim assistance.

### D. Loans Against Mutual Funds (LAMF)
- **Canonical URL:** https://www.stockstrail.in/services/loan
- **Scope:** Short-term and emergency liquidity against existing mutual fund holdings at competitive interest rates without triggering capital gains taxes or stopping active SIPs.

### E. Free Risk Profile Assessment
- **Canonical URL:** https://www.stockstrail.in/check-risk-profile
- **Scope:** Free online risk assessment evaluating investment horizon, financial responsibilities, income stability, and psychological risk tolerance to recommend conservative, moderate, or aggressive asset allocations.

### F. Paperless Demat Account Setup
- **Canonical URL:** https://www.stockstrail.in/services/open-demat
- **Scope:** Assisted account opening with leading Indian discount and full-service stockbrokers.
